from kernel import AppError, require_session


def note_detail(store, session, note_id=None):
    """Read one note by id, with its tag names sorted ascending."""
    require_session(session)

    if not note_id:
        raise AppError("INVALID_PARAMETER")

    note = store.note(note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND")

    tag_names = _tag_names_for(store, note["tag_ids"])

    return {
        "id": note["id"],
        "title": note["title"],
        "body": note["body"],
        "archived": note["archived"],
        "tags": tag_names,
    }


def _tag_names_for(store, tag_ids):
    """Names of the given tag ids, sorted ascending."""
    id_set = set(tag_ids)
    names = [t["name"] for t in store.tags() if t["id"] in id_set]
    names.sort()
    return names
